verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no API versioning scheme and no deprecation policy. The only hint of versioning is the 'order-v3' path in one documentation URL; the cited content itself never discusses API versions, version lifecycles, sunset timelines, or deprecation notices. An implied version number in a URL does not amount to a documented versioning and deprecation policy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
